Bidirectional plan-↔-ADR + spec-↔-ADR references. No production code. D12-atomic Foundation-Pack — XL exemption documented.
chunks.merge_exemption: Foundation-Pack — Plan §4.0 (the entire body of plan §4) IS this Block 0's spec. 5 ADRs + 12 architecture docs + ADR index = ~18 files, ~2500-3000 LOC of binding-contract prose. ADRs cross-reference each other (§4.0.1.0.2 quer-verweis-graph); splitting would break the type-chain of the contract. Plan-meta sections §1-§9 are the SOURCE MATERIAL the ADR/docs-writer materializes into the contract files (§1→ADR-Kontext, §2→ADR-Consequences-Positive, §3→Triangle-FSM-doc, §4→hard-rules + §4.0.6-walkthrough-docs, §5→ADR-References, §6→ADR-Consequences-Negative, §7→ADR-Decision-History, §8→ADR-References, §9→ADR-Decision-History initial-entries). No spec-references — Block 0 is plan-scoped only.
chunks.notes: Mandatory skill loads for the implementer: knowledge-adr-format + ~/.claude/templates/adr.md (per plan §4.0.1.0.3) + knowledge-doc-format + ~/.claude/templates/universal.md (per plan §4.0.2). Inline-anker setup is deferred to Phase 4.6 — Block 0 itself produces no code.

chunks.title: Block 1b/1: DictateUiState data class + DictateUiStateStore + DictateModule interface + Action sealed hierarchy
chunks.description: Foundation types for the modular orchestrator. Create state/DictateUiState.kt (12 sub-state types + pendingSessions PersistentList + 1 top-level Bool), state/DictateUiStateStore.kt (single source of truth, MutableStateFlow<DictateUiState>), state/DictateModule.kt (interface with 9 hooks: id, actionClass, read, write, initialState, reduce, reduceFailure, runEffect, onCrossModuleStateChange, terminate, prefBindings), state/Action.kt (sealed Action + inner sealed per module, including the Top-Level EffectFailure), state/ReducerContext + TransitionResult + SideEffect base. Spec 1 §3 + §4.2 + §4.4.
chunks.notes: Pure data types + interface — no behavior yet. Pairs with C4 (Orchestrator) which wires them together. Foundation-pack: splitting C3 from C4 keeps each chunk under XL; both are D12-atomic w.r.t. their own internal type-chain. Acceptance: plan §10 Block-1b section.

chunks.title: Block 1b/2: DictateOrchestrator (Composition Root) + DictateModuleRegistry + ModuleServices + ModuleServicesFactory
chunks.description: The dispatch engine. Create state/DictateOrchestrator.kt (dispatchInternal in 5 steps: cascade-limit → routing → reducer → state-write → effects async → cross-module-cascade), state/DictateModuleRegistry.kt (all-list + Init-Time sanity check for double-routing), state/ModuleServices.kt (DI container interface) + state/ModuleServicesFactory.kt (concrete wiring). Spec 1 §4.3 + §4.7 + §4.8.
chunks.notes: Initialization order: PipelinePrefMirror.attach BEFORE PipelineRecovery.recover (§4.10 contract). EffectFailure-Routing via originModuleId, NOT KClass-Lookup (Phase-B S-4 finding). Tests must verify cascade-order-determinism + shutdown-order + ProGuard-survival.

chunks.title: Block 1b/3: Core modules — Recording, Pipeline, Audio, ViewMode, Overlay (5 modules with cross-module cascades)
chunks.description: The five core modules with the heaviest cross-module-cascade traffic: RecordingModule (recording state, MediaRecorder Effects, ResetSuppressBit cascade on Idle→Preparing), PipelineModule (PipelineUiState sealed, PipelineDone cascades to Resend + LivePrompt), AudioModule (AudioFocus cascades to Recording.Pause and Recording.Preparing → AudioFocus-Request), ViewModeModule (Triangle-FSM logic with computeViewMode + 7 transitions T1-T7), OverlayModule (Overlay-state + suppressAutoOverlay handling). Spec 1 §15.2 + §15.3 + spec 1 §15.1.x coupling matrix + spec 3 §4.8 + §7.1.
chunks.notes: Heaviest module work — 5 modules with cross-module cascades. ViewMode + Overlay together implement Triangle-FSM T1-T7 (Spec 3 §7). Tests must cover ALL §15.1 cascade-arrows (plan §10 Block-1b acceptance lists 8 explicit cascade verifications).

chunks.title: Block 1b/4: Auxiliary modules — Resend, LivePrompt, Language, Layout, KeyboardInput, FeatureToggle, Theming, PendingSessions (8 modules, simpler)
chunks.description: The eight simpler modules (no complex cross-module-cascades): ResendModule (resend.lastAudioExists + resendEnabled + resendCooldown), LivePromptModule (chain-next on PipelineDone), LanguageModule (subsumes today's LanguageController — direct migration, no adapter), LayoutModule (subsumes today's KeyboardStateManager contentArea/isSmallMode — atomic setSmallMode reducer), KeyboardInputModule (Unit-state, Effect-only: Backspace/Enter/Space/InsertText), FeatureToggleModule, ThemingModule, PendingSessionsModule. Spec 1 §15.6 (KeyboardInputModule canonical) + §15.1 references.
chunks.notes: Pattern-Repeat — 8 modules, similar structure (data state, reducer, optional cascade). Once you've internalized the DictateModule contract from C5, C6 is mechanical.

chunks.title: Block 1b/5: PipelinePrefMirror + PipelineRecovery + transitional Subscribers in Service.onCreate

Plus the transitional resend-visibility subscriber in the IME-service (Block 1b Step 5 in §11.2.2) — replaced in Block 5 by LayoutCatalog.RESEND. Spec 1 §4.5 + §4.6.
chunks.notes: Tests: DictateOrchestratorInitOrderTest (prefMirror.attach before recovery.recover), DictateOrchestratorBootRaceTest (first state.value contains pref values, not DictateUiState.initial defaults — Phase-B S-1 acceptance).

chunks.title: Block 5/3: ImeViewBackend + ContentAreaController + PromptVisibilityController + OverlayResetHandler + RecordingAnimationController

Spec 2 §6 + §11.5 + §11.6 + §11.7.
chunks.notes: wireStaticHandlers ONCE at attach() — Lambdas reference stateRef/modeRef fields, NOT render-args (L8 memory-leak structural protection). Tests: UI-Test 1-10 (Espresso) per §14.2.

chunks.description: Triangle-FSM transition implementations (T1 KEYBOARD→WIDGET user-click, T2 WIDGET→KEYBOARD with SmallMode, T3 KEYBOARD→HOVER auto, T4 WIDGET→HOVER auto, T5 HOVER→KEYBOARD return, T6 HOVER→WIDGET persist, T7 HOVER→KEYBOARD pipeline-done cascade — Geist-Widget-Bug structural fix). Touch-Routing (FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL). Multi-Window-Mode + Window-Lifecycle-Edge-Cases. Spec 3 §6 + §7.3 + §4.6 + §4.7 + §8 + §11.5 + §11.6 + §11.7.
